TITLE: Operational Overview and Contractual Compliance for Tegurine Annex Use

TO: Internal Planning Subcommittee  
FROM: Liluan Nemlurel  
DATE: April 3, 2025  
SUBJECT: Tegurine Annex Configuration and Usage Parameters

Liluan Nemlurel has been tasked with reviewing the Tegurine Annex in anticipation of internal planning sessions to evaluate its suitability for upcoming organizational needs. This memorandum outlines the current status of the venue and the contractual framework that governs its use.

The Tegurine Annex has a defined seating capacity of 480 seats, as per the latest layout documentation. This figure represents the maximum number of occupants for seated arrangements. While alternate configurations may allow for more flexible use, any such changes must be formally requested and evaluated. Liluan Nemlurel is in ongoing discussions with facility management to explore the feasibility of minor adjustments that may better align the venue with event requirements. However, no formal change requests or proposals have been submitted to date.

The Tegurine Annex operates under the terms of contract number GS-9629-Z, which outlines the rights, obligations, and limitations regarding its use. A fully accessible copy of the contract is available to authorized personnel via the internal document management system. Any proposed modifications to the annex’s usage or the contract itself must undergo a formal approval process and be reviewed by legal counsel prior to execution.

Liluan Nemlurel is also coordinating with the finance lead to verify that the annex’s current and projected usage remains within the budgetary and contractual boundaries set forth in GS-9629-Z. This includes a close examination of the contractual terms related to event limitations, cancellation clauses, and ancillary agreements. As of now, no financial adjustments are deemed necessary, though this remains an active and ongoing review.

Zastama Industries is committed to maintaining compliance with all contractual obligations while ensuring that facility use supports strategic operational goals. Liluan Nemlurel will provide a detailed report and recommend next steps to the subcommittee in the near future. For inquiries concerning the Tegurine Annex or its contractual status, please direct questions to Liluan Nemlurel.
